description: Golden evaluation set — update expected_answer after each major model upgrade

items.expected_answer: Build a production-grade RAG and agent platform.
Hybrid retrieval combines dense vector search with sparse BM25 and fuses rankings using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

items.query: What is Anthropic prompt caching and why use it?
items.expected_answer: Prompt caching allows reusing previously processed prompt prefixes, reducing input token cost by up to 90%.

items.query: What safety layers does the platform have?
items.expected_answer: Three layers: input_guard (prompt injection, PII), content_filter (redaction), and output_filter (grounding check).

items.query: What is MCP and how is it exposed here?
items.expected_answer: MCP (Model Context Protocol) standardizes tool integration. The platform exposes rag_query and search_knowledge_base as MCP tools via services/mcp_server.py.
Multi-turn conversation history is stored in Redis with a TTL of 7 days, using ConversationStore in services/conversation.py.
